nativeCircuit: Allwinner A13 SBC RAM-side DDR bus: first RAM byte, then the second RAM byte on the copper just routed
capture: `bun run benchmark:ddr --circuit a13 --timeout 900` on Core main. ramByte0Request is phase-3-start.srj.json. ramByte1Connections and ramByte1Buses are taken from phase-4-start.srj.json, which is otherwise identical apart from its supplied traces. fixedConnections are the 16 connections of phase-1 and phase-2. circuit is the run's circuit.json without routed traces and error elements.
suppliedCopper: ramByte0Request.traces holds the 16 completed CPU-side routes (byte0, byte1) from Core. Preserve them byte-for-byte.
sequence: The test routes ramByte0Request, then issues the ram_byte1 request with the solver's own output as supplied copper, as Core does between phases.
geometry: Unchanged native component placements, pad centers/dimensions/rotations, stack and clearance rules.
solverCall: new BusLanesPipelineSolver(input) with no options, as Core's BusLanesAutorouter calls it.
observed: ram_byte0 routes all eight signals on TOP. ram_byte1 then fails with `Generated native surface approaches could not satisfy full-path geometry and matching`: the ball pads of N063_ddr_d11 and N075_ddr_d9 have no remaining via site or surface exit.
